title: Maximum work tape count
statement: Given a natural number $d$ and a family of Boolean finite-tape machines indexed by $j<d$, define the bank's work tape count to be the supremum of the work tape counts of the machines in the family.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $d$ and a family of Boolean finite-tape machines indexed by $j<d$
